children: , the creative-software and digital-experience powerhouse, fell approximately 0.4% to $290.47 Monday after unveiling a Saudi artificial-intelligence push valued above $4 billion. More than 27 million eligible citizens and residents will get selected Adobe tools free for 12 months. Huge audience. Zero immediate subscription bill.

The package includes Firefly Standard, premium Adobe Express features and an Arabic-prompt image model shaped around Saudi culture. The rollout should begin before the end of 2026. Divide $4 billion by 27 million potential users, and Adobe is placing roughly $148 of retail value in front of each person.

That $4 billion is not revenue. It is Adobe buying distribution, brand recognition and a future pipeline of Arabic-language subscribers. The company ended its latest quarter with $27.1 billion in annual recurring revenue and $6.62 billion in sales, so the real test comes after the free year expires. At $290.47, Adobe trades 51.1% below its $593.98 GF Value estimate. The valuation gap looks enormous, but free users must eventually become paying customers.

title: Adobe's $4 Billion Saudi AI Giveaway Barely Moves Shares
